THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ADMISSION, THIS DAY,
ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE M.NAGAPRASANNA  ORAL ORDER

The petitioners are before this Court calling in question proceedings in C.C.No.19377/2024 registered for offences punishable under Sections 498A, 504, 506, 324 read with Section 34 of the IPC, 1860 and Section 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961.
2. During the pendency of these proceedings, it transpires that the parties to the lis have entered into a settlement.

Petitioners and second respondent have filed the NC: 2024:KHC:40969 Joint Affidavit before this Court and the Joint Affidavit reads as follows:
" JOINT AFFIDAVIT
We, 1) Sri. Chidananda Murthy, S/o. Sri. Yellegowda, aged about 39 years, 2) Sri. Yellegowda, S/o. Sri. Thammanna, aged about 60 years, 3).
Smt. Sumithra W/o. Sri. Yellegowda, aged about 50 years, 4).

Sri. Madhu Gowda, @
Madhusudhna.

Y, S/o. Sri. Yellegowda, aged about 35 years, all residing at No. 73/74,
Chowdeshwari Nilaya, 3rd Cross, Neelakanteshwara Badavane, Mangammana Palya,
Bommanahalli, Bengaluru - 560 068, (the petitioner No. 1 to 4) and Smt. Shweatha.
B, D/o. Sri. Balaraju, aged about 28 years, residing at No. 208, 'A' Block, Police Quarters, Adugodi, Bengaluru South, Bengaluru - 560 030, (2nd Respondent), do hereby solemnly swear and affirm on oath as under:-
1) We are petitioners No. 1 to 4 and 2nd respondent in the above case hence, we know the facts and circumstances of the case hence we are swearing to this joint affidavit.

2) We submit that, I the 2nd respondent / 5th Deponent herein in the above case has filed criminal case in CC No. 19377/2024 for the offences punishable under section 498(A), 504, 506 section 34 of I P C and R/w Section 3 & 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act 1961, which is pending on the file of 39th ACMM at Bengaluru and charge sheet filed by the -South East Women Police, Bengaluru and I have no objection quash the above case proceedings.

sentences.text:
We submit that, I the 2nd Respondent / 5th deponent herein has filed MC No. 3259/2021 for seeking decree of divorce against the 1st petitioner herein which was settled before the Hon'ble 2nd Addl. Prl. Family Court at Bengaluru in the said M C No. 3259/2021 we the 1st deponent and 5th deponent have got settled the matter amicably agreed for decree of divorce in terms of NC:
2024:KHC:40969 the compromise before the 2nd Addl. Prl. Family Court at Bengaluru in MC No.
3259/2021, dated:
13-06-2024 4) We submit that, I the 5th deponent / Smt. Shweatha is no objection to Quash the entire proceeding in CC No. 19377/2024 for the offences punishable under section 498(A), 504, 506 & section 34 of IPC and R/w Section 3 & 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act 1961, against the petitioners / accused No. 1 to 4, which is pending on the file of 39th ACM Mat Bengaluru and charge sheet filed by the 1st respondent South East Women Police, Bengaluru.
5) We submit that, we the both parties have came to conclusion to settle the matrimonial dispute and there is force or influence from any others to make this settlement and we our-self came to conclusion and filed this Joint Affidavit with our own free consent and prays to compound above case offences.
6) We submit that kindly accept our joint affidavit and compound the offences punishable under section 498(A), 504, 506 & section 34 of IPC and R/w Section 3 &
4 of Dowry Prohibition Act 1961, against the petitioners / accused No. 1 to 4, which is pending on the file of 39th ACM M at Bengaluru and charge sheets filed by the 1st respondent to meet the ends of justice.
7) We submit that, we don't have any claim against each others, we are settled the dispute as full and final hence, this joint affidavit may kindly accept and allow the petition.

WHEREFOREE, we the deponent No. 1 to 5 respectfully prays that this Hon'ble Court be pleased to accept this joint affidavit and allow the petition by quash / compound the offences punishable under section 498(A), 504, 506 & section 34 of IPC and R/w. Section 3 & 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act 1961,
against the petitioners / accused No. 1 to 4, which is pending on the file of 39th ACM Mat Bengaluru and charge sheet filed by the 1st respondent to meet the ends of justice in the interest of justice equity."
NC: 2024:KHC:40969 3.
In the light of the settlement arrived at between the parties, I deem it appropriate to terminate the proceedings against the petitioners in the subject petition.
